newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS says confirms Brascan, Edper.
newsitem.headline: DBRS says confirms Brascan, Edper.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Tuesday that it confirmed its ratings for the debt of Brascan Ltd and the Edper Group Ltd after they said earlier today they planned to merge to create Edper Brascan Corp.
The Toronto-based ratings agency said it confirmed Brascan's senior debt ratings at BBB (high), preferred shares at Pfd-3 and commercial paper at R-1 low, all with a stable trend.

Dominion Bond also said it confirmed Edper's senior notes and debentures as well as medium-term notes at BBB with a positive trend, subordinated notes and debentures at BBB (low) with a positive trend, preferred shares at Pfd-3 with a stable trend and commercial paper at R-1 (low) with a stable trend.
The ratings agency said the merger would not change effective control of Edper and that Brascan would remain a separate entity for the near future.

"Although from an equity perspective this transaction could be viewed as a combination of interests, Brascan for the time being will remain a separate legal entity," DBRS said in a statement. "Brascan's own capital structure will not change, except that Brascan's preferred shareholders will be offered equivalent securities in Edper."
